tagline: Complex AI. Explained visually. Built practically.
title: Machine Learning vs Generative AI
disclosure: Fictional teaching scenario. Wouri Express and its people are invented; the setting draws on documented conditions in Douala, Cameroon.

onScreen.text: Two questions. Two different kinds of AI.
onScreen.emphasis: “Will this delivery be late?” and “Write the report.”

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Mbella asks two questions at Wouri Express. Will this delivery be late? And: write me the report.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: They sound similar. They need two different kinds of AI. Mixing them up is the most common mistake I see in businesses.

onScreen.title: Machine Learning vs Generative AI
onScreen.subtitle: AI Fundamentals · Lesson 3 · Predicting late deliveries at Wouri Express, Douala

messages.text: Ndedi: I plan forty deliveries a day. I want to know in the morning which ones will run late.
Ndedi: Then I can warn the customer or change the driver.

ui.title: Data on hand
lines: About 5,000 past deliveries in Ndedi's sheet
Route, time of day, weather, customer, late or not

lines.speaker: amara
lines.text: Ndedi wants to know in the morning which deliveries will run late, so she can warn the customer or change the driver.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: And she has six months of history: about five thousand deliveries, with route, time, weather, and whether each was late.

scenes.label: Decide: which AI for which question

left.title: Machine learning
items: Predicts a label or a number

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Machine learning learns from your past examples and predicts: a label or a number. Late or on time. High risk or low.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Generative AI learned from oceans of text and produces new content. Sentences, images, code. Prediction on one side, production on the other.

lines.speaker: gatekeeper
lines.text: A prediction is a probability, not a fact. Nobody gets blamed for a risk score.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Top row: a machine learning model trained on Ndedi's five thousand deliveries. It learned which routes, hours and weather go with late.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Bottom row: a generative model trained on the text of the world. It never saw Ndedi's sheet. It knows how to write.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Together they work well. The first predicts the risk. The second explains it in plain words.

steps.title: Examples in
steps.detail: Each row: facts, then the answer

items.text: Akwa shops · Monday 14:00 · dry · on time

lines.speaker: kito
lines.text: I feed the model five thousand rows. Each row has the facts, route, hour, weather, and the answer: late or on time.

lines.speaker: amara
lines.text: So it learns which facts go with late. Port before noon, rain at Bonabéri. Nobody typed those rules.

lines.speaker: kito
lines.text: Now each Monday morning, I score the day's forty deliveries. Fourteen and twenty-two: high risk. Ndedi sees it before the trucks leave.

steps.title: The confident score
steps.detail: New customer in Edéa, first delivery ever

messages.text: Delivery 40, new customer in Edéa. Risk?
Risk low. Ninety-two percent on time.

steps.title: The fix
steps.detail: Say so, then ask a person

messages.text: Delivery 40, new customer in Edéa. Risk?
Not enough history for this route. Ask Ndedi to set the risk by hand.

lines.speaker: hallucinator
lines.text: New customer in Edéa? Risk low, ninety-two percent on time. Trust me, the model has spoken.

lines.speaker: kito
lines.text: The model has never seen a delivery to Edéa. Zero rows. That score is noise. I answer: not enough history, ask Ndedi.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Machine learning only knows the past it was shown. Six months of Douala says nothing about a new town. A good system says so.

messages.text: Ndedi: Why is delivery 14 high risk?
Port route before noon on a Thursday. Nine of the last twelve similar runs were late.

ui.title: Warn the pharmacy and move delivery 14 to 14:00?

lines.speaker: kito
lines.text: Ndedi asks why fourteen is high risk. The generative side explains: port route before noon, nine of the last twelve similar runs were late.

lines.speaker: gatekeeper
lines.text: Moving the delivery and warning the pharmacy is Ndedi's call. The score informs. It does not decide.

onScreen.title: Predict with ML, write with generative AI

items.label: Microfinance
items.text: Predict repayment risk; draft the client letter

items.label: Farm cooperative
items.text: Predict yield from rainfall; write the advice

items.label: Support desk
items.text: Predict which tickets escalate; draft the reply

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Same split everywhere: predict repayment risk, then draft the letter. Predict the yield, then write the advice. Predict which tickets escalate, then draft the reply.

onScreen.title: Who owns this?
items: The model is trained on Wouri Express data and belongs to it
Ndedi checks the scores against reality every month
No driver is scored; only routes, hours and weather
Accountable: the dispatcher who acts on it

lines.speaker: gatekeeper
lines.text: The model is trained on the company's own data and belongs to it. Ndedi checks the scores against what really happened every month. No driver is scored.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Machine learning predicts from your past. Generative AI writes from the world's text. Know which question you are asking.
